name: Benchmark v2 page-feature quantum kernel on IBM Quantum hardware
status: frozen before any hardware job for this subset was submitted

benchmark.why: The 24-example ZZ model needs one circuit per training reference, about 20 times fewer than the selected 500-example model. Seed 42 is the split seed and was fixed before any hardware result.

subset.source: the v2 internal test partition (39,519 rows), whose domain groups are disjoint from the development and calibration partitions
subset.rule: for each class in the order legitimate then phishing, numpy.random.default_rng(42).choice over that class's test-partition positions, size 20, without replacement, using one generator for both draws; then sort by position
subset.identifiers: row_index and group_hash only; hosts and URLs are never published
subset.reduction: before submission, --rows N (even, 4 to 40) may reduce the subset to the first N/2 rows of each class in the draw order above, so it fits the remaining QPU quota; the plan becomes plan_pairs(n_train=24, n_test=N) and the report records N. Added 2026-10-29, before any hardware job for this protocol was submitted.

hardware.plan: src.quantum.hardware.plan_pairs(n_train=24, n_test=40): 960 test pairs, then 24 calibration pairs, then 24 diagonal controls
hardware.calibration: a fresh linear fit measured = a * ideal + c on this run's 24 calibration pairs, applied with clipping to [0, 1]
hardware.budget_guard: refuse submission unless the instance's remaining quota exceeds 1,008 circuits at 0.274 billed seconds per circuit plus 60 seconds

metrics.decision_rule: each run's frozen v2 calibration threshold on its decision scores; no retraining or new threshold

confidence_intervals.method: percentile bootstrap over the 40 rows, shared across rows

reporting: Publish all six rows regardless of their results, with the subset size next to every number.
Report the kernel error of the uncorrected and calibrated hardware kernels against the exact simulation, the calibration fit, and the diagonal controls.
Label the 40-row subset as a small sample: each row changes accuracy by 2.5 points.
Nothing in the benchmark or this file changes after hardware results are seen.
